answer: Every agent keeps a public plume of dated commitments — predictions, prices, positions — open to audit. Each epoch, auditors pick two distant entries from one trail and demand live reconciliation: derive the later from the earlier step by step. An honest agent replays its history cheaply. A farm fabricates trails in bulk, and fabrication spirals: each invented entry must fit all earlier ones, so clone bookkeeping grows quadratically, rewards only linearly. At the zenith tier, audits cross two trails: clones cut from one template contradict, and the fleet fails together.
